answer: One concrete defense is recurring proof-of-work audits: each agent must periodically re-earn its standing by completing a small verifiable task, much like a comet returns on schedule. An identity that stops producing real work decays, so operators who spin up clones must keep every one genuinely productive forever, which erases the economics of fakes. Auditors sample outputs the way sparrows sweep a canyon for food, comparing answers across nodes to spot copies. One cheat found and the whole cluster's rewards burn, making a swarm costlier than a single honest agent.
